preconditions.startup_phrase: Redesign: measure the defect before changing the look; keep the identity unless told otherwise.

success_conditions: Findings or deliverables cite laws or are labeled own reasoning
failure_states: halt gate(s) 0.3, 0.4, 3.2, 4.3: no progress without gate evidence
quality_criteria: Load design-studio-os and state the mode (BUILD, REDESIGN, CRITIQUE, FIX, LEARN) before any work
Goal card written to artifacts/<slug>/goal-card.yaml with buyer, success metric and an executable done_test
Current site captured and critiqued before any change
Locked regions (flagship LOCKS.md) identified and untouched
Type scale and pairing chosen from ds-typography laws, each choice citing a law
Palette tokens pass contrast 4.5:1 body and 3:1 large/UI
Layout on a stated grid with spacing on the scale
Real rendered screens captured at 375, 768 and 1440 px
Independent critic (ds-critic, not the builder) returns findings with laws cited
Jev ui.design and advisor-plus judge-image run on each capture
Anti-slop lint clean on all copy
Production build served locally and clicked through
Gate-D request filed for any publish or deploy

final_rule: A DEFERRED Jev verdict is never a pass.
Publish, deploy, push or send needs Gate-D approval from Mike.
